# The revolution ladder (GDD §5.2.2). On: # The port sits on the rung the angriest stratum has earned. Escalation moves one rung a day

column3: so every rung is visible and a player has a day to act on it.

# The revolution ladder (GDD §5.2.2). On: # climb_at              grievance at or above which the port moves up to this rung
# fall_below            grievance below which it drops out of this rung
# output_multiplier     what production is worth at this rung
# condition_damage      condition lost per building per day at this rung
# climb_at is deliberately above the rung below's fall_below. That gap is hysteresis: without
# it a port on the boundary would flicker between rungs every day
# and would make "pull it back out" meaningless.
# Falling is as real as climbing. §5.2.2 says every rung has an exit
# that a port can be driven into revolt AND pulled back out by playing the numbers. A ladder
# that only climbs is a timer wearing a costume.
# Deposition never falls: fall_below is 0 because it is the failure state
